records.section: CODEX DRAFT — NOT CANON / Ground truth before repainting
records.requirementOrFinding: The magenta visible in the image viewer is hidden RGB, not an opaque pink background. All 31 files have zero opaque pure-magenta and zero opaque magenta-family pixels. For example, the corner of `tafel_win` is `[255,0,255,0]`: the final zero means fully transparent. By contrast the blue-black diagonal hatching is real opaque colour: old `tafel_win` at x150/y110 is `[3,14,71,255]`. Runtime inspection found direct `load.image` loading; `greyTexOf` changes only RGB luminance and preserves alpha. It cannot turn this hatching into an uninterrupted green writing surface.
